footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income: includes a $245M income tax benefit.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 9.1% to $14.7B in 2025. Gross margin was 92.8%, versus 92.8% a year earlier, and operating income rose 8.3% to $2.6B, a 17.6% margin.
Net income rose 4.2% to $2.0B, or $3.42 per share. Operating cash flow was $4.1B and free cash flow −$6.8B, versus −$2.7B; Xcel returned $1.3B through dividends.
watch: Net income includes a $245M tax benefit.
sources: Xcel Energy Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
